summary: Reduce daemon CPU when listing many PTY sessions by reusing unchanged registry metadata

schema.detail: The registry metadata cache is process-local and reads existing JSON records without migration. The bundled PTY producer also gains an optional retention.lost-at bookkeeping tag when opt-in finished-record retention is enabled.

rules.detail: Session liveness and runtime ownership checks remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Repeated PTY snapshots share cached light metadata across runtime clones. Changed and removed registry entries are reflected on the next listing; liveness is still observed on every call. All PTY dependencies and the bundled binary advance together from 79d526d1 to merged main 0a13ed02, also including settle writer-release race handling, recorded-exit lifecycle waits and opt-in PTY_RETAIN_FINISHED retention (default off). Older 063ff7f JSON records remain readable; missing boot identity remains Unknown under the existing ownership policy.

downtime.detail: The optimization takes effect on daemon restart without migration.

manual.detail: Merge waits until the authorized host PTY upgrade: STOP 9accbcc7, planned 11-03..11-10, requires 4630c5ea or newer; bundled revision 0a13ed02 satisfies that requirement.

recovery.detail: Binary swap-back requires no data migration.
